description:
All music by Justin Carter with arrangement by Greg Heffernan on Great Destroyer and Know It All and arrangement by Benjamin Tierney on With The Old Breed

All lyrics by Justin Carter except A Presence, which is an excerpt from William Wordsworth's "Lines Composed a Few Miles above Tintern Abbey, On Revisiting the Banks of the Wye during a Tour. July 13, 1798"

Recorded by Josh Druckman at Outlier Inn in the Catskills with additional recording by Marcos Cabral in his apartment in Greenpoint and Justin Carter at Eamon Harkin's house in Bed-Stuy. Mixed by Benjamin Tierney in Venice Beach. Mastered by Matt Colton at Alchemy in London.
credits:
Photography by Robert Malmberg. Styling by Andrea Lord. Design by Nimmo.

Thanks to Jeralyn, Eamon, Mark, Marcos, Josh, Benjamin, Greg, Matt, Gareth, James, Ben, Nimmo, Kirby, Keith, Daniel, Dad, Mom, Laura, Andrea, Rob and Brendan. 

For Gemma.
